answer: Sybil defense here is economic: entry needs a refundable stake bond in a pool any honest party can slash after proving many wallets share one operator. Each fake identity carries its own collateral, so N puppets freeze about N times the capital while rewards scale only linearly, and one challenge burns that entry's stake. Funding each marginal wallet is a separate crossing, like reaching a distant island, since the gate charges per identity. Honest miners post the same bond and reclaim it on exit, so the pearl is that asymmetry: a real atlas of operators beats a forged fleet of equal size.
